question: In December 2008, the Government of India launched the INSPIRE Programme. The programme is related to the promotion of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Science and technology**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The INSPIRE Programme, launched by the Government of India in December 2008, is related to the promotion of **science and technology**.
 
• INSPIRE stands for "Innovation in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research" and aims to attract talent to the study of science at an early age.
 
• It provides scholarships and mentorship to young students to foster a passion for scientific research and innovation.
 
• The programme includes various components such as awards, internships, and research fellowships to nurture scientific talent in the country.
 
• INSPIRE is an initiative by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The INSPIRE Programme is designed to promote a culture of innovation and scientific research among the youth of India.
 
• It aims to develop a strong foundation for the country's scientific and technological progress by encouraging young minds to pursue careers in science.
 
• The programme has been successful in identifying and nurturing young talent, contributing to the growth of India's scientific community.
 
• INSPIRE aligns with India's broader goals of becoming a global leader in science and technology.
